B: abstract manifold, LC connection: an open V ∋ (p,0) in Mathlib's TangentBundle on which (q,v) ↦ exp_q v is defined and C^∞, and mfderiv of w ↦ exp_p w (w ∈ ℝⁿ ≅ T_pM via chartAt p) at 0 is the identity. A ⇒ B fails genuinely: B is about an abstract Hausdorff ℝⁿ-manifold with a smooth Mathlib RiemannianBundle and an ARBITRARY Mathlib CovariantDerivative that is Levi-Civita in Milnor's sense (IsLC: smooth, symmetric via mlieBracket, compatible = parallel fields, defined through ∃ D obeying axioms (a)–(c), keep inner products); the project has only slice submanifolds N ⊆ V with the induced metric/connection and no abstract geodesic theory (no Christoffel symbols, no D/dt or geodesic ODE in charts), and Whitney does not help since B's metric/connection need not be induced (no Nash embedding). B ⇒ A fails: B does not specialize to N ⊆ V without a bridge (↥N with ChartedSpace ℝⁿ, induced metric as RiemannianBundle, induced connection as CovariantDerivative proved IsLC, and a dictionary IsGeodesic/expMap/arcLen ↔ IsGeodesicOn/exp/pathLength), which the project does not have. A's tangent bundle is the embedded set TN ⊆ V×V, B's is Mathlib's TangentBundle with its chart structure; relating them is part of the missing bridge.
